## Type

- [ ] `fix` — corrected command, broken link, or wrong behavior
- [ ] `docs` — clearer explanation, diagram, or wording
- [ ] `feat` — new module, recipe, prompt, or lab content
- [ ] `chore` — CI, tooling, housekeeping

## Checklist

<!-- See ../CONTRIBUTING.md and ../STYLE_GUIDE.md -->

- [ ] Teaches **Codex CLI only** — no other coding agents named in lesson content
- [ ] No invented version numbers, flags, or config keys (behavior described without a version claim when unsure)
- [ ] No secrets — placeholders and `OPENAI_API_KEY` only
- [ ] Internal links resolve and code fences have language tags
- [ ] Mermaid diagrams use the standard palette and parse
- [ ] `zh/` mirror updated (or N/A)
- [ ] Metadata footer present and current where applicable
